PROJECTS
Agentic Research Assistant (personal project, 2025)
- Designed a multi-step LangGraph agent that plans a research task, calls
  external APIs, and self-corrects when a grounding check finds an answer
  without a citation.
- Evaluated the agent against a small hand-labelled benchmark, tracking
